cast.speaker: Dave
cast.description: A 19 year old male university student with a quiet, soft-spoken, low-volume, slightly nasal voice and a Mancunian northern English accent. Tired, confused and mildly frustrated, speaking in a hushed, muttering, deadpan way, never shouting.

cast.speaker: Mark
cast.description: A 19 year old male university student with a deep, soft, low, breathy voice, an intense obsessive manner and a posh southern English accent.

cast.speaker: Bobby
cast.description: A 19 year old male university student with a completely flat, robotic monotone, mid-pitched nasal American voice and no emotion at all.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dave
dialogue_lines.text: It's your turn, Mark. Roll the dice.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: It's your turn, Mark. Roll the dice.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Mark
dialogue_lines.text: Don't you get a feeling... when you watch him play like that?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Don't you get a feeling... when you watch him play like that?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dave
dialogue_lines.text: Wha... what? What do you mean?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Wha... what? What do you mean?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Mark
dialogue_lines.text: The way he moves the pieces. The way he builds... that long road of his.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: The way he moves the pieces. The way he builds... that long road of his.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dave
dialogue_lines.text: He just placed two wooden sticks on a cardboard hexagon, Mark. Just... roll.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: He just placed two wooden sticks on a cardboard hexagon, Mark. Just... roll.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Mark
dialogue_lines.text: Look at his grip on that Ore card. So dominant. He's cornering the entire mountain region and he doesn't even care who gets hurt. It's feral.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Look at his grip on that Ore card. So dominant. He's cornering the entire mountain region and he doesn't even care who gets hurt. It's feral.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dave
dialogue_lines.text: He's playing a German board game. It's the least feral thing happening in this dorm right now.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: He's playing a German board game. It's the least feral thing happening in this dorm right now.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Bobby
dialogue_lines.text: I am upgrading my settlement to a city.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: I am upgrading my settlement to a city.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Mark
dialogue_lines.text: Oh, my god. The infrastructure. The urban density. It's so thick.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Oh, my god. The infrastructure. The urban density. It's so thick.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dave
dialogue_lines.text: It's a block of painted pine. Stop... stop looking at him like that.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: It's a block of painted pine. Stop... stop looking at him like that.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Mark
dialogue_lines.text: Dave, look at his resource management. He traded three sheep for one brick at a generic port. The raw, masculine confidence to take a three to one loss just to establish dominance on the coastline. It's filthy.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Dave, look at his resource management. He traded three sheep for one brick at a generic port. The raw, masculine confidence to take a three to one loss just to establish dominance on the coastline. It's filthy.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Bobby
dialogue_lines.text: I will now play a Knight card. I am moving the Robber.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: I will now play a Knight card. I am moving the Robber.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Mark
dialogue_lines.text: Put it down. Yeah. Block that resource production. Choke his supply chain, you dirty boy.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Put it down. Yeah. Block that resource production. Choke his supply chain, you dirty boy.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dave
dialogue_lines.text: Mark, I'm physically uncomfortable, and Bobby hasn't blinked in four minutes.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Mark, I'm physically uncomfortable, and Bobby hasn't blinked in four minutes.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Bobby
dialogue_lines.text: I demand one resource card from Dave. Blind pull.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: I demand one resource card from Dave. Blind pull.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Mark
dialogue_lines.text: Take it from me instead. Take all my wood, Bobby. Take my wood!
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Take it from me instead. Take all my wood, Bobby. Take my wood!

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dave
dialogue_lines.text: You just destroyed the board. That's it. I'm done. I am transferring to a different university.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: You just destroyed the board. That's it. I'm done. I am transferring to a different university.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Bobby
dialogue_lines.text: You disrupted my trade route. I am going to dock your victory points.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: You disrupted my trade route. I am going to dock your victory points.
